summary: Notification system testing complete - All backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. 13/13 backend tests passed. Frontend notification bell, badge, dropdown, and notification history all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Browser Web Push (pywebpush) is MOCKED - push notifications silently skipped. WebSocket and in-app notifications work without it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification system fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/unread-count, PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read, PUT /api/notifications/read-all, POST /api/notifications/subscribe-push all working. WebSocket /api/ws/beneficiary accepts valid tokens. Frontend NotificationCenter component shows bell icon with unread badge, dropdown with notification history, and 'Mark all read' button. Notifications are created when coach assigns exercise/meal/reminder to beneficiary.

backend: GET /api/notifications - returns notifications list for current user
WebSocket /api/ws/beneficiary - accepts connection with valid token
frontend: Beneficiary dashboard shows notification bell icon with unread badge (3 unread shown)
Clicking bell opens notification dropdown with history
Dropdown shows notification types: exercise, meal, reminder
Mark all read button present and functional
